dedupe_keys.name: insee census housing base at iris level logement en 2022 france

description: INSEE's infra-municipal housing base from the population census gives counts of dwellings and main residences for every IRIS, the statistical neighbourhoods of about 2,000 inhabitants, and for communes not split into IRIS, so that all of France is covered. The 2022 edition, released on 16 October 2025 on the geography of 1 January 2024, counts main residences, second homes and vacant dwellings, houses and flats, main residences by number of rooms and floor area band, by construction period from before 1919 to 2019, by occupancy status and move-in date, overcrowding, parking and car ownership, with overseas-specific variables such as electricity and solar water heaters. Coverage: France except Mayotte in one file, overseas collectivities in another; about 15,500 IRIS. Access: CSV and XLSX downloads with a variable list and documentation, free. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): etalab-2.0 (INSEE: data on the site under Licence Ouverte 2.0). Caveats: figures come from the rolling census and are estimates for small areas, and IRIS boundaries change between geographies. Simulation uses are neighbourhood housing stock by age, type and size for exposure, heat vulnerability and retrofit models. Related records: the BDNB national building database and the Zensus 2022 grid data for Germany.
